name: Go lint
summary: Run bounded credential-free golangci-lint with predictable outcomes.
use_when: A Go module needs CI lint as a reusable required check.
proposed_guarantees: Failed lint fails the called job
No arbitrary shell hooks; inputs pattern-validated

evidence.basis: Candidate boundary informed by maintainer inspection of repeated golangci-lint workflow usage across admin-owned active repositories; identifying inventory is not published.

alternatives.name: golangci/golangci-lint-action
alternatives.assessment: AMSL wraps the maintained action with fail-closed inputs and SHA pins.

open_questions: Pin immutable SHA after workflows merge; two real callers before promotion.
